domain: Subtracting fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Align fractional forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities so their fractional parts are compatible for subtraction by finding a common denominator, converting to equivalent fractions, or expressing a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator and rewrites one or both fractions as equivalent fractions.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over the relevant denominator to enable part-by-part subtraction.
Tag when fractional parts of mixed numbers are rewritten into a common denominator before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag conversion of a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part into a standard mixed number; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag subtraction steps after forms are already compatible.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping after a negative fractional difference appears.

skills.name: Normalize mixed numbers
skills.definition: Convert a nonstandard mixed number with an improper fractional part into an equivalent standard mixed number before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number such as 2 3/2, 2 4/3, or 1 5/3 is rewritten into an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when extra wholes are carried from an improper fractional part into the whole-number part before subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag common-denominator conversion or rewriting a whole number as 0 over a denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag direct subtraction of already standard fractions or mixed numbers; that belongs to S03.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping during subtraction; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fractional parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when the solver combines resulting whole and fractional parts after direct subtraction, provided no regrouping is the focus of the step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is finding a common denominator or rewriting operands into compatible form.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping to resolve a negative fractional part; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Regroup one whole into fractional units when needed to complete subtraction, and simplify the resulting fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero to lowest terms when such reduction is shown.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is borrowed from the whole-number part and converted to denominator-over-denominator form such as 5/5, 10/10, 12/12, or 24/24.
Tag when the borrowed amount is added to the fractional part to continue subtraction after a negative fractional difference.
Tag when a post-subtraction step reduces a fraction or mixed number to lowest terms, including simplification to a whole number or zero.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag direct subtraction that does not require regrouping and does not include simplification.
Do not tag common-denominator preparation or rewriting a whole number as 0 over a denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
